verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs mention audit logs in two places. AI governance lets you monitor "audit logs" across a group, and agent actions are attributed to service accounts so they can be identified in audit logs. That confirms a first-party audit log exists, but neither citation describes what user or administrative actions it records or how a lead reviews it. missing for 10: dedicated audit-event documentation covering user and admin actions, instance/admin-level audit log scope, review/filter/export details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
